title: Data Scientist Markets / PE Fund Data
description: coni + partner, established 1993, is a consultancy company with headquarters in Zurich and subsidiaries in Düsseldorf and Shanghai. We are specialised in custom-fit staffing in tune with the corporate culture by ensuring a perfect match of professional skills, references and personal as well as social skills of successful candidates. Our client is the asset management division of an international bank in Zurich. We are looking for data scientists (m, f, d) with experience in the fund business as Data Scientist Markets / PE Fund Data Your Tasks: Promoting growth as part of the corporate strategy by leveraging the full potential of fund investment, contract data and client behaviour / Reviewing, analyzing, coordinating, and preparing fund data for marketing, sales, and investor relations purposes, including data in fund databases related to structured questionnaires (DDQ), requests for proposals (RFPs), requests for information (RFIs), contracts, and related business documents / Analyzing complex data sets across various platforms to gain key insights into investor behavior / Providing key data insights and trends to support business initiatives and promote relevant communication with clients / Translating insights derived from fund data into actionable projects, timelines, and compliance requirements / Taking responsibility for data quality and contributing ideas and suggestions to improve the data architecture / Applying analytical and technical expertise to support consistent, client-centric omnichannel communication / Optimizing automated data workflows and AI-powered tools to contribute to the continuous improvement of the department’s quality / Ad hoc projects. Your Profile: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in quantitative finance, econometrics or economics / Good knowledge of fund products / Essential: 2 to 3 years’ professional experience in data science following graduation, with a focus on marketing- or sales-oriented projects in the fund industry, e.g. as a quantitative consultant at one of the ‘Big Four’ accountancy firms or as a data scientist at a major asset manager / Interest in the use of AI-supported tools / Proficiency in Python, SQL and big data technologies / Strong analytical, communication and project management skills, as well as the ability and motivation to deliver high-quality business results in a demanding environment / A personality capable of taking a holistic view of both the details and the bigger picture / Team-oriented and open to discussion, with a collegial manner / High level of self-motivation and problem-solving skills / Experience of working with cross-functional business teams / Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment / Interest in project and coordination tasks / English fluent and other languages an asset. Your Contact: Mr. Ivano Coni would like to support you. Your application will be kept strictly confidential. coni + partner ag Ivano Coni Managing Director Klosbachstrasse 107 CH-8032 Zürich ----- Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
